freeze_boundary: Draft only. Materializes exactly PT-007's channel-neutral command/result split (the non-rollback obligation is NOT modelled here: Decision Register 4.2 places it on MOD-100's own module, and a const asserting what another subsystem did would make a truthful report of a real rollback schema-invalid), the permission-checked deep link its catalog row requires, and ID-005 dedupe. The retry policy, the dedupe WINDOW, the email and LINE adapter shapes, and the notification preference model (MOD-100) are NOT inferred here. This contract is owned by A5; it is materialized by A0 from the baseline and requires A5 ratification before freeze.
untestable_by_fixture: ID-005 requires that a completed or retried event does not notify a user twice BEYOND POLICY. That is a property of a dedupe store across repeated deliveries, not of one document; a fixture can carry a dedupe_key but cannot demonstrate suppression. PT-007's requirement that a delivery failure does not roll back the domain result is likewise a property of two subsystems, and this contract no longer models it at all: the `domain_result_rolled_back: const false` an earlier version carried was removed as a category error (see untestable_by_schema and delivery.x-source). Corrected 2026-10-06; this sentence had kept describing the removed const (C0 B-6).
untestable_by_schema: That a deep link's target actually exists and that the recipient actually holds the permission it demands. Both are runtime checks. Also, that a delivery failure did not roll back the domain result. An earlier version modelled it as a const, which independent review correctly graded a CATEGORY ERROR: a const asserting what another subsystem did makes a truthful report of a real rollback schema-invalid, suppressing the evidence rather than preventing the violation. Decision Register 4.2 already places the prohibition on MOD-100's own module, where it can be enforced. (2) WHAT THE BOUNDS AND THE DEDUPE-KEY CLASS DO NOT DO, declared 2026-10-07 with the bounds (open_blockers[13], A1-S3 / SC-3). `notification_id` is bounded at 128 and has no character class: an id is opaque by design (RFC-2026-009 R-5), so a name or an email address of 128 characters or fewer still validates there, as A1 measured. `dedupe_key` now has a character class that rejects `@`, `+`, whitespace and `/`, so an email address, an E.164 number and a spaced name are rejected (fixture invalid-dedupe-key-contact-detail.json); a bare run of digits, such as a local phone number, still fits, because the ids a key is built from are digits and letters. That a key's segments are opaque ids and never a recipient's contact detail is a PRODUCER obligation. The key's full COMPOSITION, ID-005's `dedupe key policy`, is A5's decision of 2026-10-10, stated in item (6). `notification_id` takes no character class (A5, 2026-10-10; RFC-2026-009 R-5). (3) `dedupe_key.minLength: 1` is now dead, exactly as CTR-USG-001's: the pattern's shortest match is five characters, so invalid-dedupe-key-minlength.json fails the pattern as well as its named rule. It is named in schema-mutation-coverage.test.mjs's UNKILLED_SITES rather than removed, because removing it is A5's edit. A5 ratified the bounds, the class and this declaration on 2026-10-10 (evidence/WP-0A-CON-006/a5-ntf-assessment-2026-10-10.md). (4) WHOSE PERMISSION THE DEEP LINK CHECKS, AND WHEN (A1's SC-2, WP-0A-CON-006 open_blockers[19]; stated 2026-10-10 by A0 before A5 ratifies, as the Product Owner's disposition of 2026-10-09 requires). The permission that deep_link.requires_permission demands is evaluated for the RECIPIENT of the notification, the person who opens the link, and never for tenant_context.actor, who caused the notification and is the only principal this document carries. It is evaluated at OPEN time, when the recipient follows the link, and not when the notification is sent: a permission granted or revoked in between decides the open. The recipient's identity does not come from this contract, which has no recipient field. It comes from MOD-100, outside this contract: MOD-100 resolves who is notified, and the open-time check takes the identity of whoever opens the link from the application that serves it, not from any field of this document. A deep link opened by someone other than the recipient is checked for that person, under the same rule. (5) A5'S STATEMENT OF THE OPEN-TIME CHECK, 2026-10-10 (A1-NTF2A-1 to -3). `requires_permission: true` is a flag that a check must run; it does not name a permission. The permission checked is the opener's permission to read the target that `target_ref` names, under that target's own access rule. The check runs in the workspace that owns the target, which for a conforming notification is `tenant_context.workspace_id`; an opener who is not an active member of that workspace is denied, whatever other workspace they belong to. The opener's identity is the serving application's authenticated session and nothing else. A delivered link, in any channel, carries no credential, token, session or user identifier, and an adapter must not add one when it builds a URL from `target_ref`; a link that grants access by being possessed is outside this contract and is refused. These are runtime obligations on MOD-100 and on every adapter; no field of this document can show them. (6) DEDUPE KEY COMPOSITION, A5's decision of 2026-10-10 (ID-005). A conforming key is `ntf:v1:` followed by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of four netstrings (`<UTF-8 byte length>:<bytes>,`) of the triggering CTR-EVT-001 event's `subject.type`, `subject.id`, `subject.version` (decimal) and `event_type`, in that order: 71 characters for every input. It contains no recipient, workspace, channel, message key, event id, attempt or time; the store scopes it by workspace and recipient. The schema admits other shapes, including the readable ones the fixtures use; conformance to this composition is a producer obligation the schema cannot show. A notification with no triggering event is not covered and needs A5's composition before it ships. The dedupe window remains MOD-100's.
